outputs.explanation: Panel A shows bar graphs with mean ± SD and statistical tests (t-test, ANOVA+Tukey), so replication is clearly involved. An 'N=4' is given (appearing near the mitochondrial fraction graph, and possibly applying to all three quantifications), so the number is reported and exceeds 2. However, the type of replicate (e.g., mice, animals, independent experiments) is never explicitly stated—only the bare number 'N=4' is given—so the replicate type is not reported, causing this panel to fail the check.

Panel B presents representative immunoelectron microscopy images of the cerebellar cortex without any quantification, averaging, or statistical analysis. As representative images, replicate reporting is not required, so this is an automatic pass.

Panel C shows a single representative western blot comparing HMGB1 detection across different mitochondrial purification methods and fractions, with no quantification, error bars, or statistical testing. As a representative blot, replicate reporting is not required.

Panel D shows a single representative western blot of a proteinase K protection assay with no quantification, error bars, or statistical analysis. As a representative experiment, replicate reporting is not required.
